newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin shown stiff but smiling on television.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin shown stiff but smiling on television.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin moved stiffly but smiled broadly in television film of a Kremlin meeting on Thursday.

Yeltsin was seen in official footage receiving Constitutional Court Chairman Vladimir Tumanov in his office. He moved slowly to a table. The film was then cut to show him sitting and talking to Tumanov.
At one point Yeltsin, 65, speaking in his characteristic low, growling voice, appeared to be expressing a desire to return to a fuller, more active life.
In a brief interview following the shots of Yeltsin, Tumanov added: "He looks better in real life than he does on television ...though it is clear the illness is still having its effect on him."
